SEARCH
Package logic

Class RegisterRequest

java.lang.Object
logic.RegisterRequest
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class RegisterRequest extends Object implements Serializable
registration request sent when a new visitor creates an account.

carries personal info plus optional subscriber details. the server validates, inserts into visitors (and optionally subscribers), and responds with a RegisterResult.

payload of REGISTER_VISITOR.

  • Constructor Details

    • RegisterRequest

      public RegisterRequest(String idNumber, String firstName, String lastName, String email, String phone, boolean subscriber, String creditCard, int familySize)
      Parameters:
      idNumber - the visitor's national ID number (5-15 digits)
      firstName - the visitor's first name
      lastName - the visitor's last name
      email - the visitor's email address
      phone - the visitor's phone number (9-15 digits)
      subscriber - true if also joining the Family Member Club
      creditCard - the credit card number (16 digits), or null if not provided
      familySize - the number of family members (1-10); 0 if not a subscriber
